# CrewWear Custom

> CrewWear Custom makes custom full-print (dye-sublimated) polyester work uniforms for US trade businesses: hoodies, long sleeves, polos, tees and caps for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping and pressure washing crews. Free design in 24 hours, no setup fees. Delivery usually takes 15 to 20 days after design approval and deposit, depending on the order. Free delivery on orders of $200 or more. Import duties, taxes and customs fees, if any, are paid by the customer.

## Key facts
- Product: full-print sublimated polyester hoodies, long sleeves, tees and polos, plus a Classic line (fleece hoodie, cotton tee, cap, neon safety vest) with logos
- Setup fees: none
- Customers: US trade and service businesses
- Free design: yes, within 24 hours, no obligation
- Delivery: usually 15 to 20 days after design approval and deposit, by express courier, each order shipped on its own
- Duties and taxes: paid by the customer
- Free delivery: orders of $200 or more
